The [[Deldrimor Reaper]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] traded by [[Artisan of Scythes]], a [[collector]] that can be found in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:Health +30
